sanskrit: kimpunarnaramekaṃsvāṅgakṣata bhavadigdhaistribhuvanamebhirvaśī kurutetilakena tribhuvanaṃ vaśaṃyātirogendra samprayuktaṃ tribhuvana vaśakārakaṃebhiḥ śmaśānatailapakvaṃ puṣpanakṣatre samastarājapatnīnāṃ vaśakṛtsakalabhūbhujendra lalanāvaśāṃkaraṇaṃ karālaye puṣpekṣoṇī hetu mahendraśikhare samutpannaṃ kajjalaṃ jagadvaśakṛtkṣipraṃ prītiṃ vināśayatiyaḥ spṛśyate sa sa vidveṣaṃ yātisitasiddhārthaiḥ spṛṣṭastrailokye kona yāti vidveṣaṃsthāvarajaṃgamajātasya prītiṃ vināśayati kiṃ punargṛhamekaṃsa carācara jaṃtu cakrasyasamabhāgābhyāṃ kṛtodhūpastrailokyasyāpi vidveṣaṇa kṛtdhūpaḥ prayuktamātre vidveṣakarastrilokasyabhavanadvāri nikhātaṃ ripumuccāṭayati saptāhātcatvāri melayitvā yadgṛhadvāri nikhanyate tadgṛhaṃ saptāhāduccāṭayatitribhuvanamapi yogavaraḥ sphuṭamuccāṭayati saptāhātsaptāhāduccāṭayati | kimutasāmānyamātranaramapisaptāhādvicintyoccāṭayet sthānātnikhanyate tasya gṛhaṃ śmaśāna sadṛśaṃ śūnyaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥtasya gṛhaṃ gata vibhavaṃ bhayaṃkarabhūtabhavabhaṃsaṃmārjyasaṃśādhya aśvagarbhakoṣṭra rūpaṃ paśyetturagakharadīrghakaṃdhararūpaṃ saṃmārjya darpaṇaṃ paśyethayagocarāhavānareti sukaraṃdarduravasāmiśraisteṣāṃ rūpāṇi pūrvavat paśyet

sanskrit: tāni darpaṇe paśyatipaśyati darpaṇa madhye rūpāṇi bhavāṃtare *? tivrajati | divyaṃ puruṣaṃ na paśyatītyarthaḥpaśyati puruṣaṃ divyaṃ prakṛtiṃ tagarāṃjanādvrajatisvabhāvasthameva bhavati rodanānnivartate ityarthaḥpunarapi purakṛtaṃ dhūpāt sarvaṃ prakṛtiṃ vrajatyāśudṛśyateprakṛtitvameti bhūyaḥ kauśika dhūpena dhūpitaṃ citraṃhastalepāt bhitti gatāni nānāyāti | ālekhyāni sparśādā karṣayati kṣiptamevatena karagarbhalepāccitrāṇi samākṣipatyāśuprakṛtīkaraṇamityarthaḥsavyena citravarṇaprabhṛtī na savyato mokṣaḥnavahalinīkesarajāgūhati guṭikā trilohagarbhasthājagatoṃtarddhānaṃ karoti | kimuta ekasya puruṣasyetyarthaḥlohatrayagarbhagataṃ gūhati vaktra sthitaṃ jagadaśeṣaṃravicandravahnimadhyagama dṛśyamānane kṣiptaṃpuruṣamadṛśye karoti | kalpalalaneti nāmākhyādvijabhuktocchiṣṭa yutā guṭikeyaṃ kalpalalanākṣātayā kṛtatilakapuruṣo na dṛśyate ityarthaḥtribhuvanamapi vinigūhati tilaka kriyayā lalāṭataṭesiddhāṃjanaṃ nigūhati asitabiḍālāśca mokṣanirvāṇaṃnigūhati | kimutānya manuṣyebhyaḥkathameva sthānena bhavatisiddhebhyopi nigūhatilalāṭapaṭṭatilakakaraṇenasārarahitāṃ hri podbhavatrāṃkuḥ prakaroti vismayaṃ loke

sanskrit: yāvadavatiṣṭhata ityarthaḥkamalamākāśānnapataṃtītyarthaḥtrikaṭuka yutena liptodaśāṃgulovatiṣṭhati vyomniavalaṃbanaṃ nirapekṣaṃ tiṣṭhatyaṃbhoruhaṃ gaganekṛte triśūladharā īśvara mūrtayo dṛśyaṃteghṛtaṃ ājyaṃ pādaṃ tayorhavanāt vaiśvā narasya prajvalanaṃ bhavaticaṃdrātape vilagnād dṛśyaṃte śūlapāṇayo rudrāḥtadā ghṛtasutasūtahavanāt prajvalanaṃ bhavati dahanasyatadā ghṛta kṣepāt śīghramagniṃ prajvālayatihomāt jvalati nitāṃtaṃ niśeṣaṃ utpādito vai dyuto'gnirjvalatitaptāhyahutihomāt prāgiti prajvālayatya nalaṃjvalati nitāṃtaṃ janito jalahavanādvaidyuto vahniḥprakaṭayati vahni madhye havanāt sauvīrakaṃ puruṣaṃcaraṇatalasaṃpralepāddhamati narāṃgāra khānikā madhyehimaśītalo vahnirbhavatītyarthaḥagnau kṣipyatena agniḥ staṃbhitaḥ śatavarṣaśatairapi āharapākaṃ na karoticaraṇatala saṃpralepāt karoti himaśītalaṃ vahniṃna pacati varṣaśatairapi vibhāvasuḥ stambhitastenasa ca romamātramapi dagdhuṃ samartho bhavatitiṣṭhati | jalena plāvyate jalastaṃbhanaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥna dahati sa caro mamapi staṃbhinaretaiḥ pradīpitopya nalaḥnijabhavanābhyaṃtara iva tiṣṭhedātmechayā dhīmānpariprakaṭaṃ yathā bhavatyevaṃ sa caratimahyāmiva salilopari paryaṭati naraḥ suvispaṭaṃṣṭaṃsakalaśrotatobhyaṃgādbhramati naronakra vatsalile
source_edition: Muktabodha M00286 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: staṃbhanamucitaṃetadoṣadhapānāt punarapi saṃsukhaṃ svastho bhavatistaṃbhayati yāna pātraṃ sarvāṃtaraṃdhragā guṭikākurvaṃti naraṃ pretakyā nayaśaṃguḍālanālābhyāṃviramo virāla catuścayemelayitvā yasya śayane nyasyate sa ca raudreṇāpasmāreṇa gṛhyatepiṣṭāniviramavaccairukmadakaraṇṭhe sarvalokānāṃśayananyastaṃ visṛjati ghoraṃ śatrorapasmāraṃ| tadā satprakṛtistho bhavatiromakeśādikaṃ svayameva patati | ata eva pradhānaṃ romaśātanametatsakṛdunmattaṃ kurute vimadokeśīti karaṇā bhavatiśātayati keśanihataṃ tathyamidaṃ keśaśātanaṃvaraṃkuṣṭhaṃ pratibhāsatetyarthaḥcarācara loke prasiddhamityarthaḥdhavalaparāhakarucayo bhavaṃti keśā nityaṃgātjñātayati keśajālaṃ yuktā sa carācare jagatisaiṃdhava haritāletyādi sugamaṃsahanavadati maunenāpi tiṣṭhate tāvat tasya śarīre prahāro nalagatiśarīre nalagatītyarthaḥ || pāṭalāpuṣpajātīyo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥkurute romavihīnaṃ prayuktamātrastrilokamapinabhiṃdatiśaṃstramaṃgaṃbhūllīsaṃtiṣṭhate yāvatravivāre puṣpadine vadana gataṃ khaḍgavāraṃ kuruteśabdārthaḥsamaraśaranikaravarṣaṃ nipataṃ taṃ vārayatyāśumāghatrayodaśyāṃ

sanskrit: kaṭitaṭavaddhairebhiḥ samīravanmedinīṃ bhramatibhūrjatva kuca teṣāṃ pādayorlepācchataṃ gachetsādhakaḥ prayāti amarahitaḥvāṃchitāni yojanāni sādhakoprajatītyarthaḥgrahaṇaṃ paśyati | kimutanikaṭasta anena yogasāmarthyaṃ darśayati divāyasamūhaṃ paśyatiebhirdarpaṇa lepādgrahaṇaṃ syād darśanaṃ bhānoḥdarśayati divāyato nakṣatra gaṇaṃ dṛgaṃjanaṃ puṣpematitāvat pramāṇaṃ caṃdaragrahaṇaṃ bhavatītijagadapitaṃ sakalajagadapi dhūpena āveśayati | kiṃ punarekaṃ satyarthaḥviśālamukhaṃ bhāṇḍamadhyasthaṃgrahaṇaṃ bhavediṃdoḥbhūtāhni jagadaśeṣaṃ dhūpādāveśayatyāśuāveśo bhavatipuruṣāṇāṃ ceṣṭāṃ haraṃtiāveśayaṃti dhūpāt svasthaṃ sa carācaraṃ lokekanakaviṭapī ca dhūpādrātrau ceṣṭā haraḥ puṃsāṃtasyāṃgaṃ kṣaṇena haṃtītyarthaḥ || karagonāsa evaviṣmrātabhāgayutairedhiḥ karogonaso bhavatilikhi spṛṣṭo viṣadastābhyāṃ bhuvibhogīnaḥpūrvoktairyogairutpāditaṃ kṛtrimameva prayātītyarthaḥdoṣadaḥ syātkṣapayati viṣaṃ vicitraṃ taṃdūlatoyena saṃyutohyagadaḥpibessūlapāṇerivaviṣanigraho bhavatītyarthaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00286 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ebhirvilipyapāṇiḥ sparśādaṃśādviṣaṃ haratipraviliptasuranādastribhuvanamapi nirviṣaṃ kurutegṛhītaṃ takreṇa pītaṃ cāturthikaṃ jvaraṃ mahāraudramapi nāśayatikṣapayaṃti bhūte divase cāturthikaṃ pāṇi baddhāniveṣṭayed dakṣiṇaṃ pūrvavaditibhūtaḍāmaraḥ prasiddhaḥgrahaketurayaṃ dhūpo durgaṃdhālaśuna hiṃgubhiryuktaḥjvalaṃtamivasādhakaśārīramanyalokairdṛśyatetatrādau dīptajvaladiva dṛśyaterajativahāṃdhakāren vigrahaṃ jvālayatyepaḥprajvalati vigrahāghaṃ rātraumallipyate kiṃcitprayachaṃti siddhadravyāṇi aṃjanapaṭukā aṃtarddhāne ākāśagāmītyādīnipaśyati prabhūtāni rātrau siddhadravyaṃ prayachaṃtigṛhamadhye sthāpita candraprabhāṃ viśeṣayati | ādhikyena karotītyarthaḥkṣapāyāṃ candrajyotsnāṃ viśeṣayatigarbhaṃ dhārayati | kiṃ punaraparānānītyarthaḥvṛkṣopari yosau vṛkṣaḥ anyaḥ utpadyate savaṃdākaḥavalihyasamprasūte kanyālokeśvaraṃ putraṃvadhyerna tena pāṇau vaṃdhyā garbhaṃ pragṛhṇātitanmadhyādutpadyateṣaṇmāsaprāṇadhāraṃ saptāḍhā vyāghramithunaṃsāhuḍakṛttivṛttairebhirnaramithunaṃ syāt trisaptāhātnārīṇāṃ garbhaṃ nivārayatītyarthaḥjīrṇagoghṛtapānād tu kāle garbhaṃ na gṛhṇātītyarthaḥnityaṃ surataniṣevaṇakāle garbhaṃ sa puṣpakaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ

sanskrit: aniśaṃ suratasaktārāmāgarbhaṃ nigṛhṇaṃtipṛthivyāṃ paryaṭangarbhartrubhītirahitā vicaratu kāmāturāraṃḍābhavati | na bhavata ityarthaḥ | hi yasmādarthaḥnaranārīṇāṃ varāṃgarbhagona bhavati | liṃgayonyādikaṃ na naśyatītyarthaḥgarbhārśave tu tasyā dūraṃ protsārite hi bhavataḥprajvalati yatra bhavane varāṃgabhaṃgo na jātu cittatrapatati stabdhameva tiṣṭhatītyarthaḥca san hayasyeva ghoṭakasyeva bhavatītyarthaḥstabdhaṃ puruṣa varāṃgaṃ dhārati ca śarvarī śakalaṃebhiḥ pralepitaṃ san puruṣa varāṃgaṃ hayasyevakāryaṃ liṃgavṛddhirbhavatietaddvayaṃ baddhvā puruṣasya kaṭi taṭe baddhe tatpuruṣasya staṃbho bhavatiebhirvarāṃgavṛddhiḥ saptadinaṃ tāmrabhāṃḍa uparyuṣitaiḥvadanavivarāṃtarasthaṃ staṃbhayati nijecchayā bījaṃtadgṛhamadhye kāmayamānānāṃ puṃsāṃ bījastaṃbho bhavatidivasakaratūlavartyādīpaśukrarodhakaḥ puṃsāṃstaṃbhayati puruṣabījaṃ yogoyaṃ yāminīṃ sakalaṃtāvat tasyārāryāyā yoni śūlaṃ bhavati taduddhṛteśaṃ mokṣaḥaṣṭāvaśeṣe pītaḥ sa kuṣṭhaṃ nivartate | trīṇi dināni yāvat kvāthaḥ peyaḥghoraṃ varāṃga duḥkhaṃ visṛjati yāvat taduddhṛteśaṃguṃjātha bhavanagojā yāvat kvāthaṃ pimālagana pibetsamūhairniraṃtaraṃ bhakṣyate uddhṛte mokṣaḥkākairniraṃtaraṃ bhakṣyate uddhṛte mokṣaḥyannāma dvijasaṃghāḥ khādaṃti niraṃtaramiha

sanskrit: tadvarcāṃtarnihitaṃ kākaiḥ saṃbhakṣyate sāpigāvaḥ nidrā rahitā yatheṣṭhaṃ saṃcaraṃtītyarthaḥsaptāvihanyamānā api nottiṣṭhaṃtyanuddhṛte tasmintu dhaute mokṣaḥdīpa ivagarbhasya sapadināryāḥ staṃbhanāryāstannāma vidarbhiteḥ siddhaḥmarutini prakaṃpaḥ sphuranmahāratnadīpa ivavṛścika viṣaṃ vinaśyaṃtirbhidaṃti daṃśasya lepenanāśaṃyātiatraiveyaṃ guṭikā devairapi atrārthe praśaṃsitāguṭikā kṛtā prayuktā vṛścikaviṣamāśusaṃharatitridaśairapistuteyaṃ vṛścikaviṣadaṃśakramaṇeguṭikā vṛścika viṣaṃ saṃkrāmayati sthānāt sthānāṃtaraṃ rayatītyarthaḥkriyatena hyāvyate ityarthaḥmadhuśarkarā samāṃśairvṛścikasaṃkrāmaṇī guṭikājaladharadhārāpātaiḥ paryaṭinaṃ karburaṃ kriyatesicyamānopi sannārdro na bhavatītyarthaḥ | etat prakaṭaṃ samastalokānāṃsārdramiti paṭa viśeṣaṇaṃna bhavati susicyamānaḥ salile nārdraḥ paṭaḥ prakaṭaḥśuṣkaṃ na dṛśyate taddaśyaṃ cāṃbhobhirāśikiṃasurasurakinnarairapi na dṛśyate saṃsthitaḥ paṭaḥ sārdraṃadṛṣṭaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥna dṛśyatetadgraṃthena dravya viliptaṃ karatala sthitamapi na dṛśyatetena karagarbhalepātvā bharaṇānyā kṣipevāmān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00286 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: spṛśyate tataḥ pratimā kṛṣṭirbhavatipiṣṭairhastatalalepāt śaṃkhaśuktyādīnāmākṛṣṭirbhavatiśākhā mṛgāsti yuktaiḥ pratimākarṣo bhavatyebhiḥaṃkolatailayuktairākarṣo bhavati śaṃkhaśuktīnāṃetairoṣadhaiḥ pakvatailāni nārīṇāṃ kuca lepāt kucāpahāraṃ kurvaṃticūrṇena rohaṃti | ata eva asaureṇu rājaścūrṇarājaḥpralepanātśaṃ prakurvatiiti janitareṇurājovarāṃgaraṃdrānyā nyāpi prarohativikāśayuktairati varāṃgaṃtasyānāryā | garbha vivarādrakta pravāho vigalaparamatiūrddhagaviṣāṇa lepāt prayāṃti cūrṇāt tathā prakṛtiṃkuhare kṣayaṃ karākṣataniddharistasyāḥetadvṛkṣa dvayarasaḥ sa ādityaraśmi tāpānmadakalalīlāṃ vidhārayativṛkṣeṇa kiṃcidapi puṣpaphalādiradvitītyarthaḥāvikaṃpayobhiṣaktaistatphalamālānaraṃ nigūhatidinakarakiraṇasparśānmadakalalīlāṃ vidhārayatisakalakusumavarṣāse tāḍito muṃcati drumastenaprayachaṃtītyarthaḥgavyaghṛtasadṛśaṃ pratibhāsate viniveśitaṃ tatra kuṃbhe sthāpitaṃmuṃcati phalakusuma cayaṃ vṛkṣaḥ khalukāma vṛkṣevakṣīraṃ yāvaccottamaṃ tāvad viniveśitaṃ sarpiḥpradhānaṃ takraṃ bhavati pānīyaṃ go rasavat pratibhāsate ityarthaḥphalasya madhyaṃgiralakṣaṇasamete ityarthaḥprakṣiptamātramaṃbho bhavati hi tasmin bhavaṃ takraṃcūrṇitaḥ prayuktastakraṃ dadhibhāvamānayati

sanskrit: matsyā anena vidhinā kṛtena punarjīvaṃtītyarthaḥbhavatītyarthaḥśītāṃbhasi matsyānāṃ bhavati punarjīvitaṃ nimeṣātkurute varāṃgabaṃdhaṃ rati samaye mṛtapuruṣayājośaṃkuḥguṭikāyāṃ tailādā kṛṣṭāyāṃ āsanādi muktaṃ bhavatileḍhī lagnau sarvāsana vaṃdhakarī guṭikaiṣāṃ kaulatailayuktā ||131|| śrī || śrī ||samasta jñeyadārtha prakāśakaṃ tejaḥ samunmīlatītyarthaḥāvirbhavati nārāyaṇāmaṃtarjyotistathāṃdha kārepiyeti anena ācārya śrīnāgārjunena viracitā ātmānaṃ nidarśayatianubhavaṃ mamāgre nītvā tanmadhyāt kiṃcidiha dṛṣṭaṃjayati sarvotkarṣena varśaṃte ityanena śāstrasyāśīrvādaṃ dadātyācāryaḥsakalajane hṛdayadayitā samarthitā sūtrato jayatiśvetāmbabhikṣaṇa jayatiāścaryayogamālā agre tava vṛddhaṭīkāvaḥgaṇeśabhaṭṭaputreṇa bhavānīśaṅkareṇa cadurmilā bhavati kṣmāyāṃ na yātu śaṭhahaṃstake harāmamīdi?abhyamitryaḥ papuḥ śabdaśāstrādhikārījanānvīkṣya sarvāndayāśīlavāhnicandrasūryagrahe caiva rajo doṣo na vidyateśatyābhadrālakānandā rajodoṣai na lipyatevāgmatī bhāratīmānyā tryahādūrddhāccakarkaṭāttāsu snānaṃ na kurvīta samudragāminī vinā
